stories.headline: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
stories.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

stories.headline: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
stories.summary: In an announcement on Wednesday , the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative . With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space , including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for…

stories.headline: State AGs fight Character AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats
stories.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

stories.headline: How people use AI agents to handle annoying tasks and save money
stories.summary: Shrugging off fears of AI, some consumers say the technology is simplifying their lives and helping them save money.

stories.headline: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case
stories.summary: Nothing is showing off a much more detailed look at its upcoming AI earbuds ahead of their December 8th release. The Ear Note buds can record your calls, while their charging case can record, transcribe, and summarize your conversations.

stories.headline: Maps show Iowa lead dust plume possibly drifting into Missouri after Army detonation
stories.summary: Maps released by the Army Tuesday show a possible plume of toxic dust after its detonation of munitions in Iowa drifting southwest toward northeast Missouri between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.

stories.headline: Kilmar Abrego Garcia releases statement after leaving U.S. for Spain

stories.headline: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
stories.summary: The discount chain has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.
